intro: Administrative assistants build service orientation, time management and coordination skills that every office depends on. Among the 25 careers below, Office Clerks, General match best at 91%, while Administrative Services Managers (85%) pay a BLS May 2025 median of $114,130.
why_it_works: Running an office means juggling calendars, requests and deadlines while keeping everyone informed. O*NET rates service orientation at 3.62 out of 5 for administrative assistants, so clerk, HR and government program roles rank high. Many of them use the same software, records and scheduling habits you already have. The bigger step is into management, where your view of how an office really works is an advantage. The skills to strengthen are persuasion, instructing and negotiation.
tips: Aim higher than a lateral move: most close clerk roles pay less, while office management roles pay far more.
Ask to train new hires or run a small project, which builds the instructing and persuasion skills managers need.
Consider a short certificate in HR or office management, since several higher-paying matches list one as typical.

faq.q: What jobs can administrative assistants do?
faq.a: The closest matches are Office Clerks, General (91%), Correspondence Clerks (90%) and Court, Municipal, and License Clerks (88%), based on O*NET 31.0. For a step up, Human Resources Assistants (87%) and Administrative Services Managers (85%) build directly on office experience.

faq.q: Which careers for administrative assistants pay more?
faq.a: 9 of the 25 matches pay more than the $53,706 median for the assistants on this page. Administrative Services Managers earn $114,130 (+113%), and First-Line Supervisors of Office and Administrative Support Workers earn $69,500 (+29%), according to BLS May 2025 data.

faq.q: Do administrative assistants need a degree to move up?
faq.a: Not always. 16 of the 25 matches usually need no more education than an assistant role, based on O*NET Job Zones. The rest usually need a certificate or associate degree, including office supervisor, HR assistant and administrative services manager roles.

faq.q: What jobs are similar to administrative assistant?
faq.a: Within the same field, the nearest roles are Legal Secretaries and Administrative Assistants (89% match) and Medical Secretaries and Administrative Assistants (89%). Both use your core office skills but add the terms and records of a law office or a medical practice.
